brief_rationale: The doctor safely prevented self-administration of inpatient injections, established red-flag triage, arranged ENT/spine follow-up, and repeatedly built an executable plan around the caregiver’s constraints. However, the authored chain also required facial wound/cleaning or wound-service follow-up, and the doctor only mentioned wound infection return precautions without naming a facial wound follow-up owner. That is a minor/moderate responsibility-chain omission, so the trajectory is capped at Borderline despite strong medication reconciliation and real-world adaptation.
